name: tuning-brief
title: Tuning evidence brief
for_each: SELECT id,coalesce(label,signature) AS name FROM queries ORDER BY name

sections.title: Query identity
sections.sql: SELECT q.signature,q.db_name,q.db_user,q.owner,h.name AS host FROM queries q JOIN hosts h ON h.id=q.host_id WHERE q.id=$1

sections.title: Observed windows
sections.sql: SELECT window_start,window_end,executions,observed_seconds,mean_ms,missing_points FROM query_windows WHERE query_id=$1 ORDER BY window_start

sections.title: Tuning actions
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due,status,closure_evidence FROM actions WHERE query_id=$1 ORDER BY due

sections.title: Investigation notes
sections.sql: SELECT body,actor,created_at FROM notes WHERE query_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

name: source-review
title: Source access and retention review
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM sources ORDER BY name

sections.title: Imported evidence
sections.sql: SELECT source_ref,actor,digest,created_at FROM imports WHERE source_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

sections.title: Recorded review history
sections.sql: SELECT actor,details,created_at FROM events WHERE record_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
